text:
Alex P.: Quick heads-up — planning to onboard model `gpt-mini-v2` to serving tomorrow 10:00 PT. Need a few quick checks: weights location, tokenizer quirks, config validation, and golden-prompt/regression prep.
Meera S.: Thanks Alex — where are the weights? I can kick off the checksum/verify step.
Alex P.: s3://redwood-models/gpt-mini-v2/2026-03-16/weights.tar.gz; sha256: 3a7f...9c1. Also uploaded a small manifest at s3://redwood-models/gpt-mini-v2/manifest.json with expected vocab size.
David L.: tokenizer note: we're seeing a couple rare tokens split strangely on our tokenizer baseline. Example: "micro-frontend" -> ["micro","-","front","end"]. Can we confirm vocab and merges?
Alex P.: good call — manifest lists vocab_size=50288 and merges file included. Meera, can you run tokenizer smoke with `--max-split 2`?
Meera S.: running now locally, will push logs. If anybody wants quick look: `python tools/tokenizer_check.py --model-dir /tmp/gpt-mini-v2 --sample 'micro-frontend'`
ci-bot: tokenizer-smoke job started (id: ci/tt-4512).
Jen K.: tiny ask for serving config: please ensure `max_sequence_length` is set to 1024 in the model config and `pad_token_id` is present. I can add a lint that rejects missing pad token.
Alex P.: added those to the draft config: `{"model_name":"gpt-mini-v2","max_sequence_length":1024,"pad_token_id":0}`. Will push to the onboarding PR in ~5.
Ricardo M.: for quality/regression: I uploaded a golden prompts pack to /evals/golds/gpt-mini-v2/goldset_v1.json. Includes structured-output example for the tool-calling tests (see snippet).
Ricardo M.: snippet: ```
Input: "Find nearby coffee shops that are open now and return as JSON with name, rating, and open_now boolean"
Expected structured output:
{"results": [{"name":"Bluebird Cafe","rating":4.6,"open_now":true}, ...]}
```
David L.: For tool-calling, note the model's tool-tokenizer sometimes splits function names when there's camelCase. Add `allowed_symbols` to the tokenizer preproc.
Jen K.: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/452 (adds config lint + pad_token check + canary rollout defaults). Pt review appreciated.
Alex P.: pinging @Meera S., @David L. for quick CRs on the tokenizer and on the manifest checksum. I want to start canary at 10:00 PT.
Meera S.: checksum verified: sha256 matches. Tokenizer smoke: two anomalies — both are hyphen-related splits. I'll add a small merge tweak and push a test.
David L.: I reviewed Ricardo's golden JSONs, looks good. One nit: prefer `open_now` boolean not string. I left a comment on the goldset file.
ci-bot: ci/tt-4512 tokenizer-smoke completed: 3 warnings, 0 failures.
ops-oncall: planning note — will configure canary (10% nodes, 30min ramp) in Redwood Console once PR merges. If anything blocks, call me.
Alex P.: sounds good. Action list: (1) Jen merge lint PR, (2) Meera push fix+test, (3) David re-check goldset boolean nit, (4) Ricardo confirm tool-call examples cover edge case of camelCase. I'll start canary after merges.
Ricardo M.: I'll add an extra tool-call case for `getUserProfile` and `get_user_profile` variants. Pushing in 10.
Jen K.: merged PR, tagging release `canary-ready`.
Meera S.: pushed tokenizer tweak & test. CI passing.
David L.: updated goldset booleans.
Alex P.: starting canary now. will monitor latency and structured-output pass rate.
ci-bot: canary-deploy job started (id: deploy/canary-1782).
ops-oncall: monitoring dashboard link: https://console.redwood.ai/rollouts/1776217890. setting alert for regression > 2% on golden prompts.
Alex P.: thanks everyone. If any regressions crop up, fallback to last-stable variant is configured.
Ricardo M.: quick note — after canary, let's add a small eval that runs tool-calling golden prompts every hour for 24h to capture drift.
Alex P.: agreed. follow-ups in the onboarding PR. :thumbsup:
